HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound)

Focused ultrasound delivered beneath the skin to support collagen and improve firmness, lift and facial contour — without surgery or injectables.

Book HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) Ask on WhatsApp

All treatments require a consultation. Results vary between individuals.

From On consultation
Session 60–90 minutes
Course Usually one session, reviewed at 12 weeks
Downtime Mild tenderness for a few days
Suitable for
  • Early to moderate skin laxity
  • A softening jawline and mild jowling
  • Anyone wanting lift without surgery or fillers
Not suitable for
  • Significant laxity that a surgical lift would serve better — we will say so
  • Implants, fillers or metal in the treatment area
  • Pregnancy, or active infection in the area

If any of these apply to you we will say so at consultation and recommend something else — or nothing.

What it actually does

HIFU sends focused ultrasound energy to a set depth beneath the skin — the same support layer a surgeon works on — without breaking the surface. That controlled heat prompts the skin to lay down new collagen, which is what firms and lifts over the months that follow.

It remodels collagen slowly, so the result builds rather than appears. Anyone promising an instant facelift from a machine is overselling it.

What to expect

A single session for most faces, delivered by a clinician who sets the depth and energy for your skin — that is a clinical decision, not a fixed setting. You will feel heat and a deep prickling during treatment, and mild tenderness for a few days after.

When we say no

If your laxity is significant, surgery gives a better result and we will refer you rather than take the booking. We review your result at twelve weeks, because that is when the collagen change actually shows.

Real results, shown honestly

Our photography standard

We publish before-and-after images only when we can stand behind every one of them. That is a higher bar than most clinics set, and it is why this space is deliberately empty until it is met.

  • Written consent for every image, freely given and revocable.
  • Identical conditions — same lighting, angle, distance and lens, every time.
  • No retouching. No smoothing, no filters, no favourable crops.
  • Dated, so you can see how long a result actually took to hold.

Aesthetic before/after imagery is regulated in the Philippines and results vary between individuals. We would rather show you real cases at your consultation than publish one we cannot evidence.
